newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Golf-O'Malley and Parsons share lead at Masters.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Golf-O'Malley and Parsons share lead at Masters.

text.p: Australians Peter O'Malley and overnight leader Lucas Parsons are leading a local charge at the A$750,000 Australian Masters at Huntingdale.
O'Malley and Parsons are locked together on 14 under par late in their second rounds.
Canada's Rick Gibson lies three shots behind the leaders, finishing his round on 11 under par.
American Tiger Woods, the tournament favourite, is six shots adrift on eight under after firing a second round 70.
